title: Gladys Reyes' 'Primera Kontrabida' MV features 'Mara Clara' co-star Judy Ann Santos
summary: Gladys Reyes has unveiled the official music video of her debut single, “Primera Kontrabida,” featuring her reunion with her “Mara Clara” co-stars including Judy Ann Santos.…

blocks.text: Gladys Reyes has unveiled the official music video of her debut single, “Primera Kontrabida,” featuring her reunion with her “Mara Clara” co-stars including Judy Ann Santos. “I want it to be nostalgic, iconic. It has a teleserye touch. But aside from that, gusto ko pang may maging participation ‘yung mga naging kasama ko sa mga teleserye,” Reyes said of the clip released by ABS-CBN Star Music on Wednesday, Nov. 4.
